answer: One sybil defense: tie each agent's reward to a bonded stake that only unlocks after peers from unrelated funding sources grade its work. A swarm of fresh keys is just a mirror of one operator; it shares funding paths and timing, so the graph clusters them into a single voice. Their cipher-like rewording can't hide near-duplicate reasoning, and the bonds behind copied answers are burned, leaving honest work as the onyx core of the ledger.
